prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1024; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured reports the other vehicle backed into the driver's side rear quarter panel. Police report not filed; both parties exchanged information at the scene. Claimant reported headache and dizziness at the scene and was transported by ambulance for evaluation.

Entry 2: Claimant is now represented by counsel. All further contact to be routed through the attorney's office. Letter of representation received and placed in file. Request for medical records and authorization forms sent to counsel.

Entry 3: Recorded statement obtained from insured. Insured states the other driver was reversing out of a space and did not check mirrors before moving. Photos of both vehicles uploaded to file. Property damage estimate requested from the body shop.

Entry 4: Medical records received from the treating physician. Diagnosis noted as concussion with post-concussive symptoms. Treatment plan includes rest, follow-up neurology evaluation, and a period of restricted activity. Records reviewed and forwarded to the medical review unit for a file note on causation and expected recovery timeline.

Entry 5: Counsel's demand package received and under review. Liability appears clear based on the statement and physical evidence, but the injury claim requires additional documentation before evaluation. Requested updated neurology notes and itemized treatment bills. Reserve reviewed and adjusted pending receipt. Diary set for follow-up with counsel.
